meta.description: Learn about Alexia Annmari and how virtual administration support is structured for busy professionals and business owners.

sections.title: A right hand for the work behind the work
paragraphs: Hi, I am **Alexia**. I provide *virtual administration and operational support* for busy professionals and business owners who need more than occasional task help.

Running a practice or company often means the meaningful work sits next to a second full-time job:

- Inbox triage and follow-ups
- Calendar logistics and client coordination
- File chaos and the systems that keep everything from slipping

That second job is where I step in.

I work with a **small number of clients** at a time so support stays thoughtful, consistent, and useful. The aim is not to hand off a few chores — it is to bring structure to what is currently sitting on you, from daily logistics to the workflows that keep the business moving.
Over time, the shift is not only *how* your business runs. It is how it *feels* to run it.

sections.title: How I approach the work
paragraphs: I start by learning how you already operate — your tools, preferences, and non-negotiables — then build support around that reality rather than forcing a generic process.
Communication stays **clear and proactive**. You should not have to wonder whether something was handled. Loose ends get tracked, progressed, and closed with ownership.
Everything is virtual and designed for professionals who need reliable coverage without adding another layer of management overhead. Ready to talk? [Get in touch](/contact).

sections.title: How we work together
sections.description: Engagements are **structured**, *collaborative*, and paced for real businesses — not one-off task lists.

items.title: Onboarding with intention
items.description: We clarify **priorities**, access, and communication rhythm so support starts clean and stays aligned.

items.title: Ownership, not ping-pong
items.description: I take work forward without needing you to chase status or re-explain every detail — *ownership*, not handoffs.

items.title: Systems that fit you
items.description: Organization and workflows are shaped around how you *naturally* work, so things stay usable day to day.
